summary: Iteration 334 — Duplicate Cleanup Tool + GPT-Live Shopper Audition end-to-end verified. Backend: services suite tests/test_duplicates_and_audition.py 5/5 pass in 6.7s (find_sets phone/email/name+sounds-alike, merge_set + errors, live Jessi _find_duplicates/_merge_duplicates/_merge_now, brain planner picks find_duplicates→merge_duplicates→confirm, shopper audition create_session with mocked OpenAI). New API tests test_duplicates_audition_api_iter334.py 9/9 pass covering: GET /api/contacts/{uid}/duplicates returns expected shape (id, first/last, phone, email, event_count, conversation_count) with reasons {phone,email,name} and correct reason_labels ('Same phone number', 'Same email', 'Sounds alike: Tod Berry / Todd Berry'); Mike Solo/Snow NOT grouped; POST /api/contacts/{uid}/merge returns {success, records_migrated, primary_id} and sets duplicate.status='merged'; 400 for equal ids, 422 for missing field, 404 for unknown ObjectId; GET /api/shop-clients/live-status forest -> on=false, configured=false, lab_live=true, reason includes OPENAI_API_KEY, plus clients_on/clients_off; GET /api/shop-clients/audition/options forest -> first 8 voices set = {gleam, marin, delta, meridian, cinder, willow, vesper, stone} and no Portuguese accents; both endpoints return 401/403 for activation-tester; POST /api/live-voice/session mode='shopper' or 'lab' -> 403 for tester, 503 with OPENAI_API_KEY reason for forest; unknown mode 'xyz' -> 503 (key check first, acceptable per spec). Frontend UI PASS: (1) forest /admin/mystery-shops shows red 'GPT-Live shopper is OFF' card with the OPENAI_API_KEY reason and 'Hear the shopper yourself' card; tapping opens audition-sheet with direction chips, 8 industry chips, dept chips, 6 challenge chips incl. random, picking a challenge shows audition-persona text with NO raw {vehicle}/{store} placeholders, audition-store/audition-offering fields present, audition-voice-auto plus 11 voice tiles (voice-gleam..voice-beacon), audition-talk visible with text 'Needs OPENAI_API_KEY on the server' and red key-reason banner shown; switching to Real estate industry updates dept chips to re_buyer/re_seller. (2) Fake WebRTC shopper audition end-to-end: after login+init-script+route mocks, tapping audition-talk opens live-jessi-sheet with title 'Shopper · Dana Whitfield', status 'Listening · gleam', hint mentions 'shopper is calling'; __dcSent contains session.instructions.append event_id 'greet_1' with content 'You placed this call, so the rep answers first. Wait for them to pick up.' (NOT default greeting); output_transcript.delta -> live-caption-assistant appears; delegation.created d1 -> NO ack_d1 sent (shopper skips ack), res_d1 IS session.thinking.append (kind thinking) with 'The line is disconnecting now', status flips to 'Wrapping up · gleam', session.close is sent within ~3s; session.closed -> 'Conversation ended · gleam'. (3) Assistant flow (Home → talk-to-jessi-btn): input_transcript.delta 'do I have duplicates' + delegation.created d2 with tool=find_duplicates open={kind:'duplicates'} -> sheet collapses to live-jessi-pill with live-jessi-pill-where '· Duplicates', app navigates to /contacts/duplicates (Duplicate Contacts visible); __dcSent contains ack_d2 (session.thinking.append), res_d2 (session.commentary.append), ui_d2 (session.thinking.append) with content 'The app just opened your duplicates on the rep's screen; they can see it now.'. (4) activation-tester /contacts/duplicates shows subtitle 'Same number, same email, or the same name spelled two ways' and three sets: 'Same email' (mail icon) Emil/E. Twin, '(500) 555-0411' phone Sarah×2, 'Sounds alike: Tod Berry / Todd Berry' — each with '2 records' and gold 'Merge into Emil/Sarah/Tod' buttons. QA Dup contacts wiped after tests (0 remain).
critical_code_review_comments: Audition voice order: spec expected first-8 = [gleam, marin, delta, meridian, cinder, willow, vesper, stone] but backend returns [gleam, marin, delta, willow, meridian, cinder, vesper, stone] — same set, different position order. Not a blocker (spec 'first' interpreted as a set); consider aligning if the intent was exact ordering (feminine-then-masculine groupings might be swapped).

merge-btn-{id} testid not attached to the outer clickable in RN Web (querySelector for [data-testid^='merge-btn-'] returned 0 while three visible gold 'Merge into <First>' buttons render). Consider adding the data-testid to the TouchableOpacity/Pressable so tests can target it deterministically. Buttons are visually correct and clickable.

Shopper audition sheet: audition-talk button uses text-based disabled indicator ('Needs OPENAI_API_KEY on the server') rather than the native disabled attribute — .is_disabled() reports False in Playwright but the button is visually and semantically inert. Consider adding aria-disabled or a real disabled prop for a11y/testing symmetry.

Empty-state QA sensitivity: the QA Dup seed absolutely must be wiped between runs — tests fail loudly when leftover data (7 sets instead of 3) is present. The pytest teardown does this correctly; if any run is interrupted, run `db.contacts.delete_many({'tags':'QA Dup'})` before re-seeding.

Shopper delegation contract cleanly verified: shopper mode emits ONLY res_{id} as session.thinking.append (no ack, no commentary) and closes the session after ~3s when end=true — matches useLiveJessi handleDelegation kind=thinking+end -> stop after 2.5s.
